answer: Propose service-weighted votes, no per-ID grants. Each ID earns one unit by clearing juniper resin from a customer-assigned 1 m² marble panel to a mirror finish. Inspectors test residue and gloss; validators accept signed panel/ID receipts once. Failed checks earn nothing; colluding inspectors can fake work. Robots are reusable capital; polish and power recur; no stake. Pooling or parallel work cannot credit a panel twice. Ten IDs earning one unit each need 10 m² of service; one ID doing 10 m² gets the same ten units.
